nodes.note: The bottom of the row: a gap in a low wall where the party comes in, with the whole street ahead of them.
Lantern Row: a cobbled street five wide between house fronts, every house door open, a figure standing inside each one.

stations.note: Where the reeve first stands: the top of the row, at the mouth of the square, facing down the street toward the gate.

nodes.note: The tailor's front room, first on the left. A figure in a grey apron stands just inside the open door.

stations.note: Just inside the door, where the figure stands framed by it.

nodes.note: The cooper's shop, on the right. Something dry and still stands inside the door.

stations.note: Just inside the door, where the figure stands framed by it.

nodes.note: The old watch-house, last on the left. Its keeper stands inside the door and looks only at the warder.

stations.note: Just inside the door, where the keeper stands framed by it.

nodes.note: The square at the top of the row, with the well in the middle of it. The reeve walks here when the party comes near, and stands by the well.

stations.note: Beside the well, facing back down the row: where the reeve stops.
